title: 3.0M-parameter dense model (width 192), same data and 2,000 steps (2.05M tokens)
note: Measured on a 4-core Linux PC with TinyStories. Perplexity is 21% lower with experts. More experts help until the table exceeds the distinct contexts in the data (small model, 800 steps: 1K experts 2.880, 4K 2.807, 262K 2.724, 1M 2.715, none 3.187). A real run of the command line tool with --params 70e9 on this PC: 69.98 billion parameters, 1.83M tokens in 23 minutes (1,340 tokens/s), validation loss 2.345 on its own split, a 74.6 GB sparse file of which 2.15 GB was on disk (520,407 experts created), 15.5 GB of flash written. Not yet measured on a phone.
